Here’s a mix of classic, modern, psychological, supernatural, and slasher horror films that have been well-received by audiences and critics alike:

| # | Title | Year | Sub‑genre | Why It’s Worth Watching |
|---|-------|------|-----------|------------------------|
| 1 | **Psycho** | 1960 | Psychological Thriller | Hitchcock’s masterclass in suspense and the iconic shower scene. |
| 2 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Psychological / Supernatural | Kubrick’s atmospheric adaptation of Stephen King’s novel. |
| 3 | **Halloween** | 1978 | Slasher | The original “killer mask” film that defined the slasher genre. |
| 4 | **The Exorcist** | 1973 | Supernatural | A chilling depiction of demonic possession that still feels fresh. |
| 5 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | Psychological / Supernatural | A modern horror masterpiece with intense dread and family trauma. |
| 6 | **Get Out** | 2017 | Horror / Social Commentary | Jordan Peele’s smart satire wrapped in a terrifying thriller. |
| 7 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | Survival / Sci‑Fi | A tense, sound‑driven horror that keeps you on edge. |
| 8 | **It Follows** | 2014 | Supernatural | A unique take on the curse trope with a haunting soundtrack. |
| 9 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | Folk Horror | A daylight horror that subverts expectations with its unsettling atmosphere. |
|10 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | Psychological / Supernatural | A metaphorical story about grief that delivers genuine scares. |
|11 | **The Ring** | 2002 | Supernatural | A modern retelling of the Japanese horror classic that still terrifies. |
|12 | **Paranormal Activity** | 2007 | Found Footage | Low‑budget film that uses minimalism to create maximum tension. |
|13 | **The Cabin in the Woods** | 2012 | Meta‑Horror | A clever twist on horror tropes that will keep you guessing. |
|14 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | Supernatural | A series of real‑life paranormal investigations turned into a gripping film. |
|15 | **Scream** | 1996 | Slasher / Meta‑Horror | A self‑aware slasher that revitalized the genre in the ’90s. |

Feel free to pick based on your preferred sub‑genre or mood!
